method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 英语教授在 Hattie 大三那年说了“怀疑是地狱的货币”这句话，此后它常在她脑中浮现。
facts.anchor: An English professor said this in Hattie’s junior year of college

facts.fact: Hattie 查看同一标题下的 Word 文档，发现它只是录音的转录文本，删掉了 Eeling 谈到自己儿子的那段题外话。
facts.anchor: it’s just a transcription of the audio minus the aside with his son

facts.fact: Hattie 合上笔记本电脑、盯着烧得差不多的炉火，随后因口渴去厨房，站在水槽边喝水。
facts.anchor: She’s very thirsty and goes to the kitchen for some water.

facts.fact: Eeling 以为自己开辟了新天地，但 Hattie、Ed 和律师 Billy Wescot 早已为 Tommy 的清白把每条路都走遍了。
facts.anchor: she and Ed and their lawyer Billy Wescot had walked smooth in their belief of Tommy’s innocence

facts.fact: 此前律师 Billy 曾建议他们改变策略、提出认罪协议，以避免可能的死刑判决。
facts.anchor: Billy had suggested they switch tactics and offer a plea deal to avoid a potential death sentence

facts.fact: 宾夕法尼亚州不实行死刑，但当年州长正竞选连任，并特意提出为 Tommy 的定罪恢复死刑。
facts.anchor: The State of Pennsylvania didn’t employ capital punishment, but the governor was up for reelection that year

facts.fact: Hattie 把笔记本电脑拿到厨房准备删除 Eeling 的文件，光标已停在“Delete”按钮上，但她犹豫了。
facts.anchor: even has the cursor over the “Delete” button, but hesitates

facts.fact: Hattie 勉强打开浏览器，重读 Eeling 为不同新闻机构写的文章；一小时后她承认他确实是位出色的犯罪记者。
facts.anchor: she opens the internet browser to reread the articles Eeling wrote for different news organizations

facts.fact: Hattie 改而煮了一杯咖啡，并开始翻查那些音频文件。
facts.anchor: She brews herself a cup of coffee instead, and with what feels like unlocking the clasp of Pandora’s box, starts to sift through the audio files.
